==Gawyn (Unlikely)==
[[Gawyn]] killed Hammer, if Hammer was a Blademaster then Gawyn is one now. --[[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 19:23, 26 February 2008 (UTC)
:: My reading is that (1) Gawyn does not perceive himself as a blademaster, probably from his comparison to Galad, (2) This is a case where men respectfully recognize another man's skills (Sleete looking at Gawyn funny when Gawyn claims he isn't a Blademaster) even though he has not been formally recognized. Rand's right to the title, Blademaster was like this too, except, of course The Dragon Reborn is obviously a blademaster. No one dared dispute that. Lastly, (3) I imagine if a blademaster gets offended by someone's false claim, they can always try to kill the false claimant. [[User:Qaexl|Qaexl]] 04:55, February 19, 2010 (UTC)
